origin: New Codex-authored native encounter under Martin's portfolio direction, using the seed's small two-phase arena objective.

technology: Godot 4.6.3 standard / GDScript / native physics, Canvas/Controls and AudioServer.
inspected_but_not_transferred: P10's preserved COMBAT_FORMULAS.csv and RM_COMBAT_RUNTIME.rb contain random accuracy/crit and level-scaled mitigation. They are not used by this deterministic real-time encounter; the related transfer remains a candidate.
accepted_differences: New 2D desktop trial with original Bell Warden, painted courtyard/runner and blade/seal/resolve/ward interactions; not restored historical 3D gameplay or franchise characters.
One enemy with three locked patterns, phase-two echo, pressure/opening tradeoffs and actual victory/defeat. No 20-boss catalogue, damage taxonomy, crafting or campaign claim.

Native source, current PCK and a standalone Linux x86_64 player are delivered. The ZIP bundles the verified Godot release runtime; the separate PCK still requires an engine. No restored Unity code, .NET compilation or other OS export is claimed.

Two actual motion atlases and delayed locked-aim blade/cast contact, recoveries and cancellation. New action commitment changes timing; baseline damage, resource costs/cooldowns, boss patterns and audio assets are retained.

0.4.0 adds standard mapped-pad analog/D-pad movement, fresh-button combat/menu actions, automatic prompts and loss/focus handling with keyboard continuity. Original combat costs, contact clocks, opponent rules and media stay unchanged.

0.5.0 adds timed close-sweep guard on L/LB, paid startup/recovery, a real blade counter opening, explicit guard/range feedback and results. Charge, wave and echo bypass guard. Existing art, audio and prior counter/seal route are preserved.

0.6.0 adds optional phase-one sweep practice through the same guard, collision, blade damage and resolve code. Explicit review/retry distinguishes early, late, range and missing-counter outcomes; no practice result counts as trial victory or human learning.
Repeated practice take resets exposed a pre-existing dual-music start race. AudioServer-locked paired starts/resets preserve alignment without changing original music bytes, gain or combat clocks.
media_origin: New P07 image_gen paintings and P08 original synthesized score/cues, integrated through native textures, semantic sound events and aligned music transports. See media/provenance.json. Prior 0.1.0 geometry/evidence remains historical.
